en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/138@0: Which of the following most closely matches your overall campaign message?
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/195@1: The United States is in the midst of a financial calamity, with masses of unemployed men on the streets. What will you do to revive business in this country?
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/139@2: What do you have to say about William McKinley's campaign, at a high level?
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/194@3: What is your definitive position on the tariff issue?
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/148@4: What do you think of leaving the Midwest for a week and making a circuit of the crucial upper South states? (i.e. Delaware, Maryland, Virginia, West Virginia, and Kentucky)

en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/questions_json/145@7:

en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1479@0/: I am a proud "wet" in the alcohol debate. What a man drinks is no one's business but his own.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/976@1/d: We support the free coinage of silver priced at a 16-to-1 ratio against gold. The results will aid farmers and workers of all classes and contribute to an American renewal.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/977@2/d: We will focus on free-silver and especially on the issues affecting farmers. We will seek a reduction in private debts and an end to the monopolistic practices of the railroads. We will also fight for the lowest possible tariffs.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/978@3/d: Silver coinage is just one part of my platform. Let's not forget the struggles of the urban worker in his efforts to unionize and obtain fair wages.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/979@4/d: I am 100% committed to the coinage of silver. It's important however, that we strike a moderate tone on other issues to expand our appeal as widely as we can.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/980@5/d: McKinley is a fanatical defender of an obsolete monetary system. He is a front-man for big business and the New York financiers.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/981@6/d: McKinley's support of high tariffs is a crime which strangles American commerce. Similar protectionist programs have twice been rejected by American voters in the past ten years alone.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/982@7/d: We may have our disagreements, but William McKinley is an honorable man. Our campaign will focus on the issues, not on the opponent.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/983@8/d: McKinley's insistence on the gold standard has alienated many prominent Republicans from his own party, such as Henry Teller.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/989@9/d: Let us bring our message to the citizens of the Pacific Coast. Winning these three states could swing the entire election.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/990@10/: Let's keep the tour as short as possible. I will take a train to San Francisco and deliver a few speeches in that city, but will not tour the entire coast.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/991@11/: There is no time for that diversion. Heaven knows what rumors McKinley will spread while I am gone, and winning the Midwest should be our primary focus.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/992@12/: New York is a traditional Democratic stronghold, and I'm confident that the people of that state will support my message. We will campaign there extensively.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/993@13/: Let's not waste our time in a hostile state. We must sow our seed upon the good earth where it will multiply.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/994@14/: I will give one big speech in New York City to open my campaign. Even if winning that state is hopeless, we need the national press.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1002@15: We will respect the rights of the states. I call for greater understanding, but certainly not for an overthrow of the natural order.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1003@16: There has been a deafening silence for many years on the issue of equal rights in the South. It's time we had a true enforcement of the 14th and 15th Amendment.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1004@17: Tillman and others have nothing to fear from me. It is the sacred duty of the white man to properly instruct and civilize the black man and other inferior races. Greater understanding must occur within this context.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1008@18: We need to focus more on Indiana and Michigan. Iowa should already be in the bag for us.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1009@19: Boies's time has passed. We need to avoid appearing with such radical politicians and cultivate the moderate wing of the party.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1010@20: Absolutely. I would be honored to give this speech.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1011@21: We need to keep it simple. Our primary goal in this campaign is to win the critical states of Iowa, Illinois, and Indiana.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1012@22: It's a shame that we need to even campaign in these beacons of the South. But if we have to, let us do it with effluence.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1026@23: It's a shame that Grover Cleveland allowed his supporters to bolt the party the moment it became clear their faction had lost this year's nomination.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1027@24: Good riddance. On the issue of silver coinage, you are either with us or you're with the industrialists. Palmer has shown his cards.
en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1028@25: I don't know how this man could live with four years of William McKinley just to save the face of his friend Grover Cleveland. No true Democrat would vote for him.

en.1896_Bryan_Matthews/answers_json/1031@28: If they can get a Bryan-Watson ticket on the ballot, good for them. We will sort this issue out after we win the election in November.
